diffs.diff: magnetic_field_uT_16bit: datasheet reading gives 0.15 per count, the part's model has 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.00006104, 0.002995, 0.007634, 0.007634, 0.007634
diffs.evidence: AK8963 datasheet (MS1356-E-02): 'Sensitivity: 0.6 uT/LSB typ. (14-bit), 0.15uT/LSB typ. (16-bit)'; BSE with BIT="1": 0.1425 / 0.15 / 0.1575 uT/LSB; Hadj = H x ((ASA-128) x 0.5/128 + 1). The model uses exactly this: the driver sets CNTL1 = 0x16 (BIT=1, 16-bit, continuous mode 2) and scales each axis by ((ASA-128)*0.5/128 + 1) * 0.15 uT/LSB, and part.json's description states 0.15 uT/LSB. The listed numbers (6.104e-05 g, 0.002995 C, 0.007634 dps per count) are the sim's accel/temperature/gyro register scales; the simulator models no magnetometer channel (buildNotes say so), so there is no magnetometer scale for the gate to match against. No mismatch exists.
